decisions.reason: The format plug-in line extends the core data integration business at low marginal cost and keeps its own page, so it likely meets aspirations and gives no reason for problemistic search.

The authentication delegation service has only a website mention and overlaps with identity offerings the firm already pruned once, so the risk of withdrawal is raised, but carrying costs are low and slack in a growing industry lets the firm keep it while results remain uncertain.
The open GIS development framework embodies the firm's strategy of open, extensible components and feeds its project business, so it is strategically central and unlikely to be dropped.
The newly launched consulting workshop uses the existing expertise and certified trainers at minimal cost and has its own page, so management will give it time to reach aspirations.
